canDoYue: 你識問租金同按金，仲識講如果今日決定就簽租約。
canDoEn: Ask about rent and the deposit, then say what happens if you decide today.

dialogue.speaker: lea
dialogue.text: Good morning. I can show you this furnished flat upstairs.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。我可以帶你睇樓上呢間有傢俬嘅單位。
dialogue.say: Good morning. I can show you this furnished flat upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: How much is the rent, and is water included?
dialogue.say: How much is the rent, and is water included?

dialogue.speaker: lea
dialogue.text: The rent is due on the first, and water is included.
dialogue.glossYue: 月租每個月一號交，水費包咗。
dialogue.say: The rent is due on the first, and water is included.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Is the deposit one month with the utilities?
dialogue.glossYue: 按金係咪一個月，連埋水電煤？
dialogue.say: Is the deposit one month with the utilities?

dialogue.speaker: lea
dialogue.text: The deposit is one month, and the rent stays fixed.
dialogue.glossYue: 按金係一個月，月租維持不變。
dialogue.say: The deposit is one month, and the rent stays fixed.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will sign the lease and pay the agency fee.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會簽租約，並付代理費。
dialogue.say: I will sign the lease and pay the agency fee.

dialogue.speaker: lea
dialogue.text: Sign the lease, and the landlord gives the keys.
dialogue.glossYue: 你簽租約，業主就交鎖匙。
dialogue.say: Sign the lease, and the landlord gives the keys.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will read the written notice before I pay the deposit.
dialogue.glossYue: 我交按金之前會睇份書面通知。
dialogue.say: I will read the written notice before I pay the deposit.
